data.long_meaning: Mariyappan is a name derived from the Tamil language, meaning 'God's grace'. This name is popular in Hindu communities and is often given to boys as a symbol of divine favor and protection. The name Mariyappan carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mariyappan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
